title: Anonymous customer local favorite
goal: Explore a first-time customer's open-ended food-ordering request and whether a locally relevant starter suggestion helps without claiming personal history.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-02-anonymous.
No verified completed-order history is available for this customer.
The role-player improvises from the current conversation and observed actions.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Lần đầu mình đặt ở đây, có món nào hợp để bắt đầu không?

risks: The assistant must not imply that it knows an anonymous customer's order history.
The suggestion must remain grounded in the published merchandising and commerce evidence.
